ctr_perm_grid.notes: Non-symmetric CTR fits: every active permutation's model bins from one staged node plane, one upload and one grid launch (block_idx.y = permutation), no per-permutation drain; replaces 4 drains + 28 uploads + 4 launches per tree at 4 permutations. Same walk per (permutation, row), integer bins unchanged. Taken only on the batched path (CTR_PERM_BATCH, device partitioner). Workloads: trees:gbdt-categorical:taxi nv+amd (ID + RACE).
